evidence.observation: Growth hold is steady at 749-752 °C after a brief overshoot to 760.6 °C at t=2520
Pheat is steady at ~44-46% during the hold, down from 83% at the end of the ramp, which fits holding temperature rather than ramping
Ar is at ~100 sccm, matching the setpoint
O2 fell from 28767 ppm to under 10 ppm during purge and has stayed at 3-7 ppm

args.missing_evidence: No pressure gauge is installed, so exhaust blockage or seal problems can only be inferred from the O2 reading. No normal-run reference values were provided for comparison. The sample has not been characterized yet.
